newsitem.title: GERMANY: Coca-Cola picks new German ad agency.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola picks new German ad agency.

text.p: Coca-Cola's German unit said on Friday it had awarded its main advertising account to agency Michael Conrad & Leo Burnett (MC & LB).

Publicis International, which won the beverage giant's European account two years ago, will continue to represent the company's brand name internationally, Coca-Cola GmbH spokesman Gert Bommersheim said.
The Frankfurt-based MC & LB will only represent the company's Coca-Cola brand and none of its other products, Bommersheim said. He declined to comment on the size of the account's budget.
German trade media had recently said that Chris Jordan, marketing director of Coca-Cola in Essen, had had disagreements with members of the Publicis group.
But Bommersheim said it was still possible that Publicis could work for Coca-Cola in Germany.
"Publicis, purely theoretically, could still work on specific projects for Coca-Cola (in Germany)," he said.
